patterns.note: A dark, grid-based layout with full-width content sections, using a subtle grid pattern in the background for texture.
Prominent, wide, and bold display typeface for main headings, creating a strong visual impact, contrasted with a more standard sans-serif for body text.
High contrast between a deep purple-grey background and off-white text, punctuated by a vibrant, multi-color rainbow accent palette used for lines and interactive elements.
Parallaxing 3D-rendered magnet elements in the hero section move and rotate at different speeds as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth and playfulness.
Sections are visually separated and connected by continuous, scrolling colorful 'tape' lines that act as a dynamic branding motif throughout the page.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that slightly reduces in height and gains a solid background color upon scroll, maintaining navigation visibility.

Hero elements, specifically the scattered 3D magnet graphics, are animated with a parallax effect, moving and rotating at varying speeds relative to the scroll position, creating a sense of depth. This is likely achieved using css-keyframes for the individual element transformations and scroll-triggered JavaScript for timing.
Content sections below the hero appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, likely triggered by scroll events.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, wide, bold display headings (~4-5x body text) for impact, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners for most interactive elements and content blocks, giving a structured, almost retro-digital feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a comfortable line height for body text.

standout: The distinctive retro-futuristic aesthetic, particularly the use of 3D-rendered, parallaxing 'magnet' elements and the continuous, scrolling 'tape recorder' rainbow lines, creates a strong, playful, and memorable brand identity. This unique visual language elevates the site beyond a typical marketing page.
